The answer is 0 if there are no 1s. Otherwise it is the product of the distances between consecutive 1s, since each piece must hold exactly one 1 and the cut positions between consecutive 1s are independent. I checked each expected output against that rule. The last case has 30 gaps of 2, so the answer is 2^30 mod (10^9+7) = 1073741824 − 1000000007 = 73741817.
